label: bounded-import-native-gzip-astc
measurementScope: Unity Editor Play Mode, actual production Game.Start and World.GenerateRoutine. Memory totals include the Editor. Object totals include all loaded Editor/assets; scene mesh totals are reported separately. These are NOT iPhone/Safari/WebAssembly/GPU-process measurements.
peakScope: Per-counter maxima of samples observed between game frames; not an exact intra-frame allocation peak. No forced GC, UnloadUnusedAssets or altered production loading path is used by this harness.
compilationScope: UNITY_EDITOR is defined: WebGL-only player code guarded by !UNITY_EDITOR (including the buffered engine path) is not exercised.
baselineScope: A label is metadata only. Source hashes identify the tested revision. Historical baseline claims require a separately preserved original source/build.
